protocol: Source S011-S080 all MI runs. Each validation/test person R04 calibration, R08 neural stopping, R12 evaluation. All feature/C/prior/neural/gate policies selected on validation-person R12 and frozen before test-person R12. EA covariance reference uses R04 MI only, never R08/R12. Rest and direction trained separately; rest adaptation uses R04 T0/MI; calibration burden explicitly reported.
selection_metric: Mean per-subject balanced accuracy for MI; mean seed probabilities for neural policy. Best linear policy and best neural policy both tested as prespecified comparisons; recommended family fixed by validation score, not test score.
gate_selection: For each cap: maximize validation correct MI candidates/all MI subject to pooled rest FPR cap, tie lower FPR then greater direction threshold. Rest family selected for the primary 20% cap before test. 20% is an exploratory prototype operating point, not a safety standard. No smartphone execution.
evaluation_status: Exploratory follow-up on previously inspected S095-S108; no fresh external confirmation. R12 trial IDs identical to v3 calibration for paired comparisons. Source pretrained EEGNet selection already used validation people in v2; reused development evidence disclosed.
safety_scope: Offline cued windows only; candidates require human confirmation. No continuous rest, cross-day, clinical, target population, free thought or phone control claim. Cached sub-band filtering is causal but resets at each window; not validated streaming pipeline.
